notes:

requirements_summary:
Workload: low-latency chat + batch reranking + embeddings for search.
Latency/throughput targets: p95 <350ms for short-chat flows, sustained 50 concurrent chats, batch rerank jobs overnight up to 500k docs.
Model preferences: want open-weight model variants but will consider Redwood catalog; need quantization options for Dedicated.
Routing/fallback: want automatic fallback to smaller cheaper variants when Dedicated pool under pressure.
Compliance: SSO, SOC2, audit logs, KMS, US data residency.
Cost sensitivity: moderate; procurement pushing for committed capacity if cost per token delta >20% vs incumbent.
migration_notes:
Current provider: OpenAI (usage since 2024). Core migration concerns: prompt parity (tokenization differences, sampling), API compatibility (function-calling payload shape), and reranker score scale differences causing downstream threshold drift.
Action items agreed: produce mapping doc (OpenAI->Redwood) for SDK calls, run 1:1 prompt parity suite (1500 canonical prompts), and compare output diffs with golden thresholds. If regressions >5% on key intents, need model/config tuning.
POC metrics to collect: latency p50/p95, token cost, rerank precision@5 delta, semantic similarity of generated responses, error rates (429/503), and KV cache hit-rate.
